question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Establish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Demolish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Establish"** means to set up or create something, especially an institution or system, in a firm or permanent way. (स्थापित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The government plans to establish new schools in rural areas to improve education facilities.
 
 
 
• **"Demolish" **refers to the act of destroying or tearing down something completely, especially a building or structure. (ध्वस्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The old factory was demolished to make space for a modern shopping complex.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Establish' **is **'Demolish'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Demolish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Charge **(आरोप लगाना): To accuse someone of an offense or responsibility.

 
 
• **Example:** The police decided to charge the suspect with theft.
 
 
 
• **Enlarge **(बड़ा करना): To make something bigger or more extensive.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to enlarge its headquarters to accommodate more employees.
 
 
 
• **Alert **(चेतावनी देना): To warn someone about potential danger or problems.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather department issued an alert for heavy rainfall in the region.
